requirements.name: Stream handshake
requirements.requirement: Every captured beat obeys valid/ready; no output changes while stalled. Independently vary input valid and output ready.

requirements.name: Input FIFOs
requirements.requirement: Fill, empty, simultaneous push/pop, full-to-pop recovery and depth 2/4. Verify registered ready and absence of combinational top input-to-output paths by structure/timing review.

requirements.name: Metadata
requirements.requirement: Every source and qid; duplicate tags; changing non-SOP user metadata; preservation of meaningful fields and zeroed output reserved bits.

requirements.name: Length sweep
requirements.requirement: 1, 7, 8, 9, CELL_BYTES−1, CELL_BYTES, CELL_BYTES+1, MAX−1 and MAX. Compare all valid bytes and final keep.

requirements.name: Multi-cell data
requirements.requirement: Distinct per-byte patterns across cell and word boundaries; no corruption or missing final partial cell.

requirements.name: Single-beat commit
requirements.requirement: New head cell and descriptor fields must bypass correctly when admission and EOF service coincide.

requirements.name: Basic admission
requirements.requirement: Empty pool, valid header, exact reservation and one descriptor. All selected policies/reasons match the specification.

requirements.name: Cell-credit boundary
requirements.requirement: U=n, U=n−1 and same-cycle release. Admission uses pre-cycle U, not optimistic reclaimed resources.

requirements.name: Descriptor exhaustion
requirements.requirement: Exhaust descriptors with short packets before cells; release descriptor at packet EOF, not queue dispatch.

requirements.name: Queue limits
requirements.requirement: H[q]+n exactly at and one above limit; include receiving, queued, TX and aborted ownership in H[q].

requirements.name: DROP mode
requirements.requirement: Reject for each resource reason, drain to TLAST, emit one disposition, allocate no resources to a rejected header.

requirements.name: WAIT mode
requirements.requirement: Hold a temporarily unserviceable head while other eligible inputs progress; resume after resources become available. A packet larger than its static queue cap is rejected rather than waiting forever. Document per-input HOL behavior.

requirements.name: Reason priority
requirements.requirement: Make two or more predicates fail simultaneously and check the specified priority.

requirements.name: Multi-input headers
requirements.requirement: Capture SOPs simultaneously on four interfaces; service/reserve in internal RR order without overbooking.

requirements.name: Physical uniqueness
requirements.requirement: Live cells have unique owners; no free cell is also allocated; double-free detection cannot inflate capacity.

requirements.name: Reservation equations
requirements.requirement: Check A+F=N, F=U+R and U+sum(H)=N each event batch, including multiple releases.

requirements.name: Read/write ports
requirements.requirement: No more than one payload read and one payload write per cycle; no physical word collision.

requirements.name: Output read credits
requirements.requirement: Buffered+outstanding responses never exceed FIFO capacity; long stalls start immediately after read bursts. Run read latency 1 and 2.

requirements.name: Cell retirement
requirements.requirement: Free a cell exactly on its final accepted output beat; capture its next link before reuse. Force rapid reuse of just-returned cells.

requirements.name: Descriptor returns
requirements.requirement: Coincident TX completion, abort completion and new admission; two set bits and one clear bit are merged correctly.

requirements.name: Basic FIFO order
requirements.requirement: Several packets per queue from different inputs; expected order follows internal valid commit, not external SOP order.

requirements.name: Last dequeue plus enqueue
requirements.requirement: Queue has exactly one descriptor; concurrent dequeue/enqueue must leave the new descriptor at head and tail.

requirements.name: Longer queue race
requirements.requirement: Concurrent enqueue/dequeue at count>1; next links, tail and count all agree with the abstract list.

requirements.name: Different queue updates
requirements.requirement: Enqueue one queue while dispatching another; no state update is lost or applied to the wrong queue.

requirements.name: Empty dequeue
requirements.requirement: Empty queue cannot dispatch, including a concurrent first commit; next-cycle visibility is explicit.

requirements.name: Input completion order
requirements.requirement: A short packet on one input commits before an earlier-started long packet on another input; preserve the resulting queue commit order.

requirements.name: Eligible grants
requirements.requirement: No dispatch from an empty queue; descriptor/length belong to its head; no double dispatch.

requirements.name: Credit discipline
requirements.requirement: Add quantum once per visit, debit packet bytes once per dispatch, freeze during TX stalls and avoid counter wrap.

requirements.name: Small quantum
requirements.requirement: A large packet eventually becomes eligible after several visits; credit carries rather than resets while backlogged.

requirements.name: Empty/reactivation
requirements.requirement: Deficit resets on true empty transition; same-cycle enqueue/dequeue uses merged count; later arrival cannot inherit idle credit.

requirements.name: Mixed packet sizes
requirements.requirement: Saturated 64/1536-byte flows with equal and unequal quanta; compare delivered bytes, not packet counts.

requirements.name: Progress
requirements.requirement: Under explicit progressing-sink assumptions, continuously backlogged queues obtain service; no lost activation. No unconditional latency claim under infinite external stalls.

requirements.name: Bad headers
requirements.requirement: Invalid qid encodings and zero/oversize declared lengths; no resource allocation.

requirements.name: Bad keep
requirements.requirement: Sparse/empty keep, partial nonfinal beat and wrong final mask; no partial packet reaches output. Include a first-beat error with zero allocated cells and deferred descriptor return.

requirements.name: Early TLAST
requirements.requirement: Abort and reclaim an admitted packet at each representative word/cell boundary.

requirements.name: Missing/late TLAST
requirements.requirement: Detect error at the expected final beat, stop writes, drain to a later TLAST; unrelated inputs progress.

requirements.name: Abort concurrency
requirements.requirement: Several input aborts while normal output cells return; bounded ports, no starvation of cleanup under allowed traffic.

requirements.name: Complete cleanup
requirements.requirement: After valid streams stop and bad frames drain, all cells/descriptors return and IDLE becomes true.

requirements.name: Reset state
requirements.requirement: RUN=0, all valid outputs low, empty queues and full pools; packet-memory contents need not be zero.

requirements.name: Reset in flight
requirements.requirement: Reset during RX reservation, commit/dispatch race, sink stall, outstanding RAM responses, abort cleanup and AXI-Lite responses. No stale new-epoch output.

requirements.name: Register map
requirements.requirement: Reset values, capabilities, all implemented qids, unmapped/misaligned accesses and RO/WO semantics.

requirements.name: Independent AW/W
requirements.requirement: AW before W, W before AW, same cycle, and long separation. No coupled-channel assumption.

requirements.name: Bus backpressure
requirements.requirement: BREADY/RREADY stalls, read/write overlap, no lost response, one-outstanding transaction limits.

requirements.name: Write strobes
requirements.requirement: Each byte lane, zero strobes, merged-value range checks and rejected atomic updates.

requirements.name: Configuration lock
requirements.requirement: Busy disable and running configuration writes reject without changing behavior. Reconfiguration after legitimate drain succeeds.

requirements.name: Statistics
requirements.requirement: Snapshot coherence, low/high read order, pre-update capture, live/shadow separation, clear restrictions and reset.

requirements.name: Parameter matrix
requirements.requirement: F0/F1/I0/I1/E0/E1; counters/indices at minimum sizes; invalid elaborations rejected.

requirements.name: Throughput
requirements.requirement: Saturated large packets against one-read/one-write ceiling; identify scan, metadata and boundary bubbles.

requirements.name: Fairness
requirements.requirement: Complete-round/visit service accounting; distinguish dispatched from delivered bytes at finite endpoints.

requirements.name: Shared capacity
requirements.requirement: Equal-capacity shared/fixed admission models; hot, uniform and adversarial queue usage.

requirements.name: Implementation trade-off
requirements.requirement: Two mapped memory/pipeline configurations, same library/PVT/load conditions, functional latency accounted for.

requirements.name: Triage integration
requirements.requirement: Actual regression failure invokes the utility and produces a reviewable report tied to seed/config/revision; evidence and final outcome are preserved.
